TITLE: Quantum Ferro-Chromatic Singularity
DESCRIPTION: Transcendent 3D psychedelic flow uniting a gyroid-sculpted liquid-chrome and black-opal ferrofluid sculpture with a volumetric 3D quantum-orbital interference cloud (|psi1 + psi2 + psi3|^2). Features 12 live-wired controls across 4 UI groups, 5 factory presets, and a deterministic beat-synced QuickJS script.

CONTROLS.NAME: speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Bipolar quantum orbital flow and ferrofluid rotation speed; negative values reverse curl spin.

CONTROLS.NAME: audioDrive
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Couples all 8 FFT bands into Rosensweig ferrofluid spikes, camera bass punch, and orbital cloud density.

CONTROLS.NAME: warp
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 3D gyroid curl distortion sculpting the liquid-chrome core and swirling probability filaments.

CONTROLS.NAME: ribbonMix
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Scales the orbiting liquid-mercury trefoil ribbons and smooth-min blend radius around the core.

CONTROLS.NAME: mirrorAxis
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Engages quad-mirror kaleidoscopic symmetry for hypnotic Rorschach liquid-chrome visuals.

CONTROLS.NAME: quantumGlow
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Volumetric density of the 3D quantum-orbital interference cloud surrounding the sculpture.

CONTROLS.NAME: chromeSheen
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Studio neon softbox strip reflectivity across the liquid-chrome and black-opal surface.

CONTROLS.NAME: accentTint
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Oil-slick thin-film phase shift and studio neon softbox chromatic hue.

CONTROLS.NAME: intensity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Master HDR exposure into ACES filmic tone mapping.

CONTROLS.NAME: invertSolar
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Activates solarized liquid-mercury negative inversion for dramatic breakdown contrast.

CONTROLS.NAME: quantumSurge
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Momentary quantum-tunneling shockwave igniting the probability filaments and chrome Fresnel rim.

CONTROLS.NAME: focus
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: 2D camera orbital yaw (X) and pitch (Y) around the liquid-chrome singularity.

PRESETS.NAME: Default
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Signature liquid-chrome ferrofluid core wrapped in luminous oil-slick quantum interference filaments.

PRESETS.NAME: Deep Warehouse
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Heavy dark mercury sculpture with slow reverse curl, moody low nebula haze, and aggressive bass spikes.

PRESETS.NAME: Peak-Time Strobe
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Quad-mirror Rorschach chrome symmetry with hyper-warped filaments, rapid spin, and electric neon strips.

PRESETS.NAME: Iridescent Dream
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Silky oil-slick nebula bloom with wide orbiting trefoil ribbons and calm high-elevation drift.

PRESETS.NAME: Sub-Bass Minimal
PRESETS.DESCRIPTION: Pure sculptural liquid-mercury core with restrained volumetric cloud and razor-sharp studio chrome reflections.
